question: What most likely explains the spike in refund requests last week?

evidence.text: The primary shipping carrier reported regional delivery delays starting Monday.
Refund requests citing 'item never arrived' rose 3x starting Wednesday.
Overall order volume was flat week over week.
A billing-page redesign shipped on Tuesday of the same week.

units.text: Carrier delays began two days before the refund spike, and total orders did not change.
The delay in delivery is the more likely trigger for 'never arrived' refunds than any unrelated site change.
The refund spike is most likely explained by the shipping-carrier delay.
It is unknown how many affected customers will re-order once delivery catches up versus stay churned.
